permissions.name: Admin All
permissions.description: Full admin access

permissions.name: Approval Templates Manage
permissions.description: Author and manage approval templates (create, edit, publish, archive, template groups) and administer approval delegations; the same template-admin guard also accepts approvals:admin-templates

permissions.name: Approvals Act
permissions.description: Take decision actions on approval instances (approve, reject, return, transfer, add/reduce sign) through the approval action endpoints. Route-level capability: each route evaluates whether the holder may act on a given instance

permissions.name: Approvals Admin
permissions.description: Perform administrative approval recovery actions

permissions.name: Approval Data Recovery Admin
permissions.description: Perform approval data recovery operations without template administration privileges

permissions.name: Approval Template Admin
permissions.description: Manage approval templates without approval process recovery privileges

permissions.name: Approvals Analytics
permissions.description: View person-level approval process analytics (performance aggregations)

permissions.name: Approvals Read
permissions.description: Read approval instances, history, comments, delegations, and pending/todo queues — also gates a few write-shaped actions sharing this same guard (see the migration file header); not a pure read-only grant

permissions.name: Approvals Write
permissions.description: Start approvals: create and preview approval instances from published templates, keep form drafts and upload draft attachments. Does not allow acting on an approval (approvals:act) or authoring templates (approval-templates:manage)

permissions.name: Attendance Admin
permissions.description: Manage attendance rules, settings, and schedules

permissions.name: Attendance Approve
permissions.description: Approve or reject attendance adjustments

permissions.name: Attendance Import
permissions.description: Import attendance records and manage import batches

permissions.name: Attendance Read
permissions.description: Read attendance records and summaries

permissions.name: Attendance Write
permissions.description: Create attendance punches and adjustment requests

permissions.name: Comments Read
permissions.description: Read comments and discussion threads

permissions.name: Comments Write
permissions.description: Create, update, resolve, and delete comments

permissions.name: Demo Read
permissions.description: Read access for demo purposes

permissions.name: Demo Write
permissions.description: Write access for demo purposes

permissions.name: E-learning Admin
permissions.description: Global e-learning administration

permissions.name: E-learning Grade
permissions.description: Grade exam attempts within authorized scope

permissions.name: E-learning Read
permissions.description: Read published learning content and own attempts

permissions.name: E-learning Stats
permissions.description: Read learning statistics

permissions.name: E-learning Write
permissions.description: Create and edit learning content and exams

permissions.name: Multitable Manage Schema
permissions.description: Create, rename, retype and delete multitable fields (table structure) — NOT implied by multitable:write

permissions.name: Multitable Read
permissions.description: Read multitable bases, sheets, views, and records

permissions.name: Multitable Share
permissions.description: Manage sheet-level multitable access overrides

permissions.name: Multitable Submit Approval
permissions.description: Submit a multitable record to an approval template (record-level send-for-approval) — NOT implied by multitable:write; the approval product still requires approvals:write

permissions.name: Multitable Write
permissions.description: Manage multitable bases, fields, views, and records

permissions.name: Spreadsheet Read
permissions.description: Read spreadsheet resources and cell data

permissions.name: Spreadsheet Write
permissions.description: Create and update spreadsheet resources and cell data

permissions.name: Spreadsheets Read
permissions.description: Read spreadsheet resources and cell data

permissions.name: Spreadsheets Write
permissions.description: Create and update spreadsheet resources and cell data

permissions.name: Stock Prep Admin
permissions.description: Workbench-scoped stock-preparation administration (no pack install; may relabel still-English managed-table headers to their Chinese template names when the operator switch is on; includes the puller tier, which may create one per-project stock-preparation sheet from the frozen template when the project-sheets switch is on)

permissions.name: Stock Prep Operate
permissions.description: Confirm stock-preparation queue decisions and read back own value entry

permissions.name: Stock Prep Pull
permissions.description: Pull from PLM into the stock-preparation sheet (dry-run, apply, large-BOM background channel, reconcile); in later slices also create project sheets and archive/restore them. The holder must also hold stock-prep:operate and stock-prep:read

permissions.name: Stock Prep Read
permissions.description: Read the values-free stock-preparation confirmation queue

permissions.name: Tasks Admin
permissions.description: Administer task settings in the caller org

permissions.name: Tasks Read
permissions.description: Read tasks in the caller org

permissions.name: Tasks Write
permissions.description: Create and update tasks in the caller org

permissions.name: Test Read
permissions.description: Read access for testing

permissions.name: Test Write
permissions.description: Write access for testing
